metadata.title: Calabi flow in the controlled Kähler cone
metadata.abstract: We prove that the geometric limit of a global Calabi flow in a real class of the controlled Kähler cone is independent of the initial metric. Under cohomological K-polystability, the limit is a smooth cscK metric in the original class and complex structure. We also establish varying-class closedness and an equivariant continuity method. We apply this method to construct a smoothly varying family of cscK metrics throughout an explicit interval of symmetric real Kähler classes on the blow-up of the projective plane at four points in general position.
